label: Matched one-act and formal-mode controls with explicit differentiation
paraphrase: Finite controls reuse AxiarchicFoundation and PossibiliaContent. A necessary actual source has one real constituent, non-real unproduced modes, a good-general favouring, one generic operation, and an actual contingent effect in the SAME CausalityFrame. The appInner assignment apprehends all modes in the one operation and meets the existing root criterion and recognition bridge; appNone apprehends none and fails both. Common-source, common-act and uniform-apprehension descriptions preserve c/d exchange; the explicit primitive value table breaks it. The noninjective realizer maps and failed bare-description factorization are checked. These are initial structural assignments; appNone alone is not mind-independence, rigidity is not proved modal necessity, and the separate restored-grounding model adds positive semantic constraints.
